title: Conversation browser

search.title: Nomi local web search
search.busy: Local browser capacity is busy. Ask the Agent to try again shortly.
search.challenge: The search engine requires verification or consent. No results were retrieved.
search.timeout: Search timed out. Ask the Agent to retry if needed.
search.failed: Search failed. Ask the Agent to retry if needed.
search.invalid: Search results are incomplete or unavailable.
search.openFailed: Could not open this source. Click the link to try again.
search.isolated: Searched with an isolated local browser · No conversation sign-in state used

systemBrowser.title: Signed-in Chrome
systemBrowser.description: Use Chrome's existing sign-in state without moving data. Chrome permits access to the selected profile's windows; NomiFun limits the Agent to tabs you authorize for this conversation. Disconnecting does not close Chrome or its tabs.
systemBrowser.setup: Requires Chrome 144+ on Windows. Open chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging in Chrome and allow remote debugging, then connect here. NomiFun will not launch Chrome or enable that setting for you.
systemBrowser.unavailable: System browser connections are currently available only in the Windows desktop app.
systemBrowser.cancelUnconfirmed: Cancellation could not be confirmed. Refresh the status or try cancelling again; no connection request will be replayed.
systemBrowser.noChoices: No available tabs. Open a webpage in Chrome, then choose tabs again.
systemBrowser.noAuthorizedTabs: No tabs are authorized for this conversation.
systemBrowser.locked: Stop the Agent before changing this connection or its authorized tabs.
systemBrowser.requestFailed: The request could not be confirmed. Refresh the connection status before trying again.

states.cleanup_failed: Disconnect could not be confirmed — retry disconnect

dialogLeaveWarning: Changes you made may not be saved. Leave this page?
dialogTruncated: Some website text is too long to display in full.
dialogAgentHandling: Agent is handling this website dialog.
dialogExpired: The dialog response could not be confirmed. Check the current page before trying again.
shortcutsUnavailable: Browser keyboard shortcuts are unavailable. You can still use the toolbar.
clearSiteDataWarning: Closes all pages in this conversation, discards unsaved page content, and clears website sign-ins, site storage and cache. This cannot be undone. Other conversations, your system browser, chat messages, project files and downloaded files are not affected.
clearSiteDataDone: This conversation’s site data has been cleared.
clearSiteDataFailed: Site data removal could not be confirmed. Some pages may have closed. Reopen the browser before trying again.
addressCopyFailed: Could not copy the page address. Please try again.
externalHandedOff: Sent to your system browser. Its sign-in state is separate; this page remains open here.
externalFailed: Could not open the system browser. Ensure the Agent has stopped and the current page is a web URL, then retry.
openDownloadsFailed: Could not open the system Downloads folder. Check that it is available, then try again.
downloadEmpty: No downloads in this browser session
downloadCancelFailed: Could not confirm cancellation. Check the download status and retry when the Agent has stopped.
rebuildWarning: All page tabs will close and unsaved page content will be lost. Conversation messages and project files will not be cleared.
rebuildFailed: The browser could not be reopened. Ensure the Agent has stopped and finished cleanup, then retry.
addressPlaceholder: Enter a URL or localhost address
invalidUrl: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL
stopHint: Stop the Agent to browse manually
hostUnavailableHint: The conversation browser is not supported on this device yet.
requestFailed: The browser could not complete this operation. Retry to reconnect before continuing.
linkLocked: The Agent is running. Stop it, then click the link again to open this page.
linkBusy: The browser is not ready. Click the link again when it is ready.
linkFailed: Could not open the link. The Agent may have started, or the page may be unavailable. Try again when the browser is ready.
linkMapped: This link used {{host}}, a server listening address. Opened its loopback address on this computer.
permissionRetryHint: Website permission was cancelled or denied. Reload the page to request it again.
permissionExpired: This permission request ended or the page changed. Request access again from the page.
startHint: Enter a URL above. This browser belongs to this conversation. When the Agent starts, it can read and interact with these pages.
